method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); dates in a small module, the rules in one module and the claimant's questions in a seat module importing it; two regulative rules (the time bar and the s 39 notice) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Limitation Act 1981 (NT), reprint REPL026 as in force at 11 August 2025, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/Limitation-Act-1981-NT-current-reprint-REPL026.txt (text sha256 b12e58acd95629d7f0c9f57b4b7d7209b8328c29a94687198dcfee1c7ae0d3be), retrieved from legislation.nt.gov.au on 2026-11-06

seat: the claimant: the individual to whom a cause of action accrues and who brings or proposes to bring the action (injured person, worker with a dust disease, survivor of child abuse, family member suing for a death, person defamed, party to a contract or deed) (nla-seat.l4); the s 8 and s 24 questions are asked by the same individual answering a claim (counterclaim, contribution)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run nla-dates.l4 ; l4 run nla-rules.l4 ; l4 run nla-seat.l4 ; l4 run nla-cases.l4
checks.result: 124 assertions written, 124 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics were read; l4 prints each diagnostic twice, so satisfied assertions were counted by distinct source range. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: Focus: the provisions a claimant meets. In: ss 4 (person under a disability, disabled person), 5, 5A, 8, 9(2), 11, 12, 14, 17, 24, 36, 38, 39, 40(1)(e), 41, 42, 43, 44, 44AA, 44A, 44C, 48A, 53, 54, 55, 56(1) (ss 37, 40, 44AAB, 44B, 44D, 49, 50 in descriptions). Out: ss 1-3, 6, 7, 9(1), (3), 10, 51, 52, 56(2)-(4) and the Schedule (machinery, transitional, Crown, equity saving); ss 13, 15, 16, 18-23, 25-35E, 45-48 (account, judgments, penalties, arbitration, conversion, admiralty, equitable relief, income, mortgages, trusts, money paid under mistake by way of tax).
